scripts.dev:all: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
